name: grid-beam
title: Grid Beam
description: A rounded near-black panel split by faint grid lines into rows and columns, with small glowing beams sliding along the lines and brightening where they cross. Meant to sit behind a headline or product card.
use: A dark product panel needs a technical grid that quietly pulses behind a headline.
avoid: It needs a sized parent: the canvas fills an absolute box and is invisible without height.
a11y: Canvas and dividers are aria-hidden, but the beam loop runs continuously with no reduced-motion option. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded near-black panel is divided by thin grey lines into four rows and six columns. Short teal, orange, magenta and purple light streaks appear on the lines, brightest at crossings. A small outlined badge, a white headline and two grey lines of copy sit in the middle.
behaves: Small glows travel along the horizontal and vertical lines at slightly different speeds and pulse gently; where two beams meet at an intersection the spot glows brighter. The grid lines and the copy never move.
customise: rows, cols, colorVariant (colorful, mono, ocean or sunset), theme, active, duration, strength, breathe and borderRadius are props; palette colours live in the source.
weight: heavy: Draws dozens of gradient blurs on a 2D canvas on every animation frame.
